body.name: Essential-witness legal-lifting handle
body.construction: Start from the selection-aware canonical DAG transformations of Carey et al., retain the unnormalized selection coordinates in the moment map, partition each exogenous input by the full response tables of Duarte et al., and adapt the sourcewise support reduction of Rosset, Gisin, and Wolfe by carrying positive essential-parent and inducing-path witness strata; at a vanishing witness boundary, search all COPAG-allowed architectures for an equal-moment legal representative.
